verdict.rationale: Secureframe is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only a REST API with an OpenAPI reference and an MCP server, which can use an API key for CI jobs and scripts. These are developer building blocks and an adjacent feature, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
